# Butler v0.0.9

## Change Log

- Added the Butler App integrated distribution path with bundled Agent runtime
  activation and app-managed background service setup.
- Added packaged macOS and Linux App installer support, including macOS `.pkg`
  and Linux `.deb` artifacts for x64 and ARM64.
- Updated first-run setup so language selection, safety notice, Agent setup,
  and model setup run inside the App.
- Added App-owned Linux and Windows titlebar controls, anchored to the window
  edge without macOS traffic-light spacing.
- Simplified first response preparation progress so internal model/tool-loop
  details are not shown as duplicate user-visible work rows.
- Added App release manifests and update manifests for App-managed Agent
  versioning.
- Refreshed README install guidance for the current App-first release shape.
